content_sections.heading: NHM Thiruvananthapuram Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NHM Thiruvananthapuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NHM Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Specialist Doctor post is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available in NHM Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Specialist Doctor in the National Health Mission Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Specialist Doctor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or equivalent qualification, along with a Medical PG Degree/Diploma/DNB in the respective specialty and permanent registration under TCMC/Kerala Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Specialist Doctor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Specialist Doctor post is 63 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Specialist Doctor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 78,000/- per month. For Paediatrics and Dermatology, it can also be Rs. 2000/- per sitting (max).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NHM Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NHM Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for NHM Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the National Health Mission Thiruvananthapuram office. The exact venue details are available in the official notification.
